versions.changelog: Generalized personal trade history, specific stock names, and examples. Now universally applicable. BS sheet kept with make-a-copy instructions.

- Initial release of the investing-analyst skill.
- Provides a structured, thesis-driven workflow for equity and options trading analysis.
- Includes a 3-gate pre-trade checklist to ensure discipline and edge identification.
- Outlines rules for comparing options Implied Volatility (IV) to Historical Volatility (HV).
- Defines strict position management rules to prevent emotional trading and manage risk.
- Includes clear trade type definitions and a required trade log template for every entry.
